name: Maria Scissorland
original_name: マリア・シザーランド
source:
A very ordinary skilled herbalist with an attractive body. Good at saving money.
Maria is very quiet and introverted but at the same time she is courageous, frugal, and kind.
She is generally very prude, but in romantic situations she lets her sexiness go wild.
